title: docs(skills): objectstack-formula teaches label() over a multi-select and the timestamp() refusal over a date field
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9171vgqqqLwGXb1ijPmb3ta)_

Fixes #34444
Fixes #34450

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对外发布的 `objectstack-formula` 技能补两句已上线行为——`label()` 用在多选字段上会按读者语言读出每个已选项的标签、按存储顺序用 `, ` 连接(空选择读 `''`);`timestamp()` 只认完整时间戳文本，对日期字段会被构建拒绝(`date-text-call`),日期平移要写 `isoDate(addDays(record.d, n))`。各配一条 eval。
- 为什么改：这两项行为分别由 #34443、#34447 落地，但 AI 作者只读技能、不读文档页；不教的话会继续给每个选项建一个字段，或写出 `timestamp(record.borrow_date) + duration('168h')` 这种每行都失败的公式。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文本、eval、token 棘轮一行和 changeset,不动任何代码与契约。先删三处重复内容付账，余下 +11 token 按维护者常设裁决「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」抬上限(5997 → 6008)。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`(`label(record.f)` 行与 `Plus CEL built-ins` 段，以及三处删除)、`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 的 formula 行注释、`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` 新增的 11、12 两条。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 formula 行读 `6008 / 6008`,全部文件在上限内。
- 需要你做的：审批这个受治理 PR(Tier H,`skills/**`);席位会在 L1 与达档契约复审通过后补席位记录再请审。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, the published formula skill, now teaches two behaviours `@objectstack/formula` already ships:

1. **`label()` over a multi-select** (#34444, the `Skills-docs:` follow-up of PR #34443). The `label(record.f)` row adds: a multi-select (`multiple: true`) reads each selected label in stored order, joined with `, `; `''` for null *or an empty selection*. Wording follows `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` as PR #34443 landed it.
2. **`timestamp()` over a date field is refused** (#34450, the `Skills-docs:` follow-up of PR #34447). The built-ins line that lists `timestamp(s)` adds: `timestamp()` parses only a full ISO instant, so over a `date` field (`YYYY-MM-DD`) the build refuses it (`date-text-call`), `+ duration(…)` included; shift a date with `isoDate(addDays(record.d, n))`. Wording follows the formulas page row PR #34447 landed and the `firstDateTextCall` docblock in `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` (a `datetime` field's text is an instant and is not refused, so the sentence names the `date` field only).

`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` gains one case per card (ids 11 and 12).

**Token ceiling — paid down first, raised by the measured remainder.** The file sat at headroom 9. Under the standing maintainer ruling of 2026-10-27, verbatim and untranslated, 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068, letter B), three restatements were cut, each keeping another home:

| Cut | Its other home |
|:---|:---|
| `has()` paragraph: "To check for "value present and non-blank" use the stdlib helper `isBlank()` or compare to `null` explicitly." | the cheat-sheet `Null check` row (`record.foo == null` or `isBlank(record.foo)`) and the next paragraph's "`!= null` is the whole guard" |
| template section: "`shared/expression.zod.ts` declares both surfaces and their carriers." | Core contract ("declared as `Expression` / `ExpressionInput` in `shared/expression.zod.ts`"), the table's `Carriers` column, and See also |
| translation-table note: "on update and delete events it is bound per matched row — see §5" | the §5 `previous` table's `after*` / `before*` / bulk rows; the note keeps its pointer `(§5)` |

Arithmetic in priced bytes (stamp line excluded), against `main`'s 23952: the text adds 321, the cuts remove 243, landed 24030 → `ceil(24030 / 4)` = 6008. The row moves 5997 → 6008 (+11), pinned at the measurement, with the arithmetic in the row comment. No re-wrap was used to pay.

**Line and token readings (os-dev.md, `skills/**`):**

| | before | after |
|:---|---:|---:|
| `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` lines | 492 | 493 |
| `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` tokens | 5988 | 6008 |
| all `skills/**/SKILL.md` lines (whole package) | 4592 | 4593 |
| all `skills/**/SKILL.md` tokens | +0 elsewhere | +20 (this file only) |

Net line budget set at the claim: +4 on the SKILL.md; used +1.

## Tests

No code changes. The two eval cases are the exercise: id 11 asserts `label(record.no_margin_reasons)` and refuses a hand-built `joinNonEmpty`; id 12 asserts `isoDate(addDays(record.borrow_date, 7))` and refuses `timestamp(record.borrow_date)`. No existing test was changed.

## Acceptance notes

- Fold: one PR for two cards that edit the same file (claim 6931123459 on #34444, member claim 6931145551 on #34450); one commit per card plus one paydown commit.
- Model tier: the `--tier` reading is MANDATORY `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` for `skills/**`; this PR was authored at `TIER_DEFAULT` under the proactive low-headroom downgrade (claim `Container & model:` line). The compensating control is the at-tier contract review routed by the seat to the review seat. Contract review owed.
- Out of scope: the "Shift a date" row of the Dates table already names `addDays`; it is unchanged.

## Verification
